text:
mino (product): quick thread to capture a short, contract-friendly 'cookbook' for enterprise safeguards: audit exports, BYOK/KMS, retention lanes, attestation options. keep it bite-sized.
tara (eng): agree. recommend staging-only MVP that we can sign off on: cloud-KMS BYOK, 90d hot search + on-demand NDJSON export, tenant retention flag with TTL job. no cold WORM until phase 2.
alisa (security): must record key_metadata (kms_key_ref, attestation_token if present), rotation events, and a signed export manifest for legal reviews. auditors want deterministic fields.
ben (sales): Prospect asks: two banks want timeline + what we will commit to in SOW. one will accept partner attestation, the other insists on HSM attestation. they both want documented acceptance tests.
cara (custeng): pilot ask: fast forensic path for last 30m (<60s), an export-sample endpoint for legal review (sample size param), and tenant-level retention toggles. phased ok.
mino (product): propose acceptance checklist (short): A) BYOK handshake: POST /v1/keystore/handshake -> audit row with kms_key_ref + handshake_status + attestation_token? B) Forensics fast-path: GET /v1/audit/export?tenant=X&start=&end=&sample=100 -> first page <60s, NDJSON rows contain required fields. C) Retention enforcement: set retention=7y -> run TTL job -> export shows tombstone entries + signed manifest referencing chain-of-custody.
tara (eng): technical caveat: fast-path requires hot index for 90d window. 7y cold archives will be paginated and may require rehydration; add cost-per-GB-year estimate and opt-in billing.
alisa (security): acceptance must include regression harness that asserts fields: request_id, timestamp, tenant_id, route, model_version, kms_key_ref, attestation_token (if present). also require signed manifest: SHA256 over NDJSON + signer id and timestamp.
contracts-bot: ticket COMP-91234 created: "Safeguards acceptance cookbook + signed-manifest spec" assigned to product/eng/security/legal.
ben (sales): customers will want the acceptance script or a signed run report. can we commit to producing a signed manifest after staging run?
cara (custeng): yes please. also document export rate limits and page sizes so legal can review.
tara (eng): we'll add `?sample=` param and `X-Export-Signature` header for the manifest. include example NDJSON record in the spec: {request_id, ts, tenant, route, model_ver, kms_ref, chain_id}.
alisa (security): for HSM requests, offer partner-attestation path (PartnerHSM) for enterprise tier. acceptance condition: attestation_token present in handshake audit row and included in manifest.
mino (product): rollout plan by tier: Tier 1 pilot (partner-attest customers) -> sign-off on staging tests -> limited prod rollout to paid pilots -> Phase 2: native WORM and legal-hold API.
tara (eng): next steps: I'll draft the tech spec + example NDJSON + export-signature format by EOW. alisa will add attestation checklist. contracts to draft SOW language referencing COMP-91234.
ben (sales): I'll line up pilot POCs and tell them acceptance will be the signed manifest + passing harness.
cara (custeng): note for pilot ops: include a small synthetic dataset and a replay harness so customers can run the acceptance script themselves.
mino (product): perfect—keeping this tight for Phase A. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
